displayName: GitPR — AI Commit, Code Review, PR Publisher & CI Check
description: Thin MCP client for GitPR CLI: generate Conventional Commits, run AI code reviews, publish Pull Requests, and inspect unified check diagnostics.
cfg.mcpCommand: Executable used to launch the GitPR MCP server (default: gitpr-mcp).
cfg.mcpArgs: Additional CLI arguments passed to the MCP server executable.
cfg.provider: Optional AI provider override (gemini, deepseek, ollama). Leave empty to inherit ~/.gitpr/.env.
cfg.checkUseAI: Enable AI code review inside GitPR: Check. Disabled by default to keep interactive editor checks fast and token-free.
